messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "never share an injection pen even if you changed the needle"
set: ["never share an injection pen even if you changed the needle", "do not share pen with other people even if pen needle has been changed", "store pen without injection needle attached", "never share with another person", "never share your medicines with others", "remove needle after each injection", "use new needle for each injection", "discard the pen 30 days after first use, even if medicine remains", "do not share this medicine with another person even if they have the same symptoms", "remove and safely discard needle after each injection", "keep using even if you feel well", "use an injection on the same day each week", "change in mental health even if you are an adult over age 24", "do not share with another person even if they have same symptoms", "subcutaneous injection using pre-filled single-dose pen", "use only the injection pen that comes with insulin glargine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
